text: We shall have all eternity to celebrate the victories, but we have only the few hours before sunset in which to win them.
reason: This mindset fills me with the urgency to fight the good fight that is so easy to lose.

text: If a preacher is not first preaching to himself, better that he falls on the steps of the pulpit and breaks his neck than preaches that sermon.
reason: It's easy to fall into a routine, but this quote reminds me of the gravity and responsibility of preaching genuinely.

text: He is no fool who gives what he cannot keep to gain what he cannot lose.
reason: No amount of money or worldly honor is worth compromising what God has in store for us in eternity!

text: I will keep the ground that God has given me and perhaps in his grace he will ignite me again. But ignite me or not, in his grace, in his power, I will keep the ground.
reason: When I am in a spiritually dry season, this prayer and declaration becomes the truth I cling to. The Walk is not always 'on fire', but I can always keep the ground God has given me.
